BiblicalUsage: Machpelah was the cave Abraham bought for a burying place, named in Genesis 23:9, where he asks for the cave of Machpelah for as much money as it is worth, and in Genesis 23:19, where he buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah. Genesis 25:9 says Isaac and Ishmael buried Abraham himself in the same cave.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Machpelah is the first piece of the promised land Abraham ever owned: a grave, bought with silver, holding the promise of more to come.
